intro: Outside the lab I read, cook, practise yoga and occasionally build things that fly. This page is a short, informal account of that.

sections.title: Reading
sections.body: I read mostly literature and philosophy, and I like books that stay with me after the last page. A few I keep returning to:

books.title: Aristotle and Dante Discover the Secrets of the Universe
books.author: Benjamin Alire Sáenz

books.title: Aristotle and Dante Dive into the Waters of the World
books.author: Benjamin Alire Sáenz

sections.title: Writing
sections.body: I write about people, emotions, relationships and the small turns of everyday life: reflections, letters and thoughts that do not fit anywhere else. At IIT Bombay I also edited for the department's editorial board, where I interviewed alumni about their careers and wrote for the department magazine, newsletters and social media.

sections.title: Cooking
sections.body: I enjoy trying new recipes, ingredients and cuisines. For me cooking is a hands-on way to learn: you change one thing, taste, and find out what happened.

sections.title: Yoga
sections.body: I completed NSO Yoga at IIT Bombay and took on the 54 consecutive Surya Namaskar challenge.

sections.title: Making things
sections.body: I earned an Exemplary Design & Innovation Certificate in a two-month RC plane competition. My MS101 project was among the top 24 of more than 700 undergraduate projects and was shown at the IIT Bombay project exhibition.
